question: Where should the right fist be placed to complete the described gesture?
premises: The right element is to be acted upon.
The head is specified as the location.
Placement on the head is prescribed.
inference: The right fist should be placed on the head.
uncertainties: Whether dakṣam refers to the right hand or the right fist is inferred from the preceding verse.
plain_english: And one should place the right one on the head; thus it is done.
